subject: MAP & procurement cadence — sequencing for MSA/DPA + order form
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@medshift.com>

Cc: sara.white@medshift.com
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff + initial MSA redline and order form template

Hi Rachel / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at MedShift is excited about Redwood's throughput profile. We pulled together a short MAP and the initial redline on the MSA for your legal team to review. High-level asks from procurement:

- Fast lane review of key commercial terms (SLA, termination, liability cap)
- DPA confirmation for EU data residency options added to the order form
- SOC2 evidence for the last 12 months

I'm attaching the Mutual_Action_Plan (tabbed by milestone) and our initial MSA redline. Can we align on a sequencing that doesn't push past the end of June? Sara (procurement) is copied — she can share PO cadence constraints.

Proposed first pass timeline: 1) Legal redline review by Redwood (3 business days), 2) Commercial review + pricing confirmation (2 business days), 3) DocuSign execution windows. If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-min alignment call early next week.

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_MEDSHIFT.xlsx, MSA_v3_redline.pdf

Best,
Alex Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships
MedShift Therapeutics

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + initial MSA redline and order form template

Alex / Sara — thanks for the docs and the clear asks. Laura and I will be your points for sequencing; copying Karthik from legal for the redline review. Quick read and proposed sequencing below that keeps the end-of-June target in view.

Proposed sequencing (minimal risk path):
- Day 0 (today): Redwood legal & product intake; confirm any critical clauses that require exec review
- Day 1–3: Legal deep review + targeted redline (Karthik) — return comments inline to your MSA_v3_redline.pdf
- Day 4–5: Commercial alignment on any pricing or SLA edits (Laura)
- Day 6–7: Finalize Order Form with data residency flag and DPA addendum (template attached)
- Day 8–10: DocuSign window & procurement PO submission

Open items we need from your side to keep this schedule: SOC2 evidence (summary + auditor report excerpt), confirmation on desired data residency (US / EU), and any non-standard procurement terms (e.g., specific PO lead times).

I can take a 30-min slot Monday 10–10:30 PT to review the MAP line items and who owns which milestone. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: OrderForm_template.xlsx

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 13:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: MedShift MAP sequencing + ask summary (DEAL-98321)

Team — looping you in on the MedShift MAP; external thread is below. Highlights / risk flags:

1) Commercial: wants close by end of June; they are sensitive to PO timing — Sara will push if executed before 6/25.
2) Legal: MSA_v3_redline.pdf includes increased liability cap and an SLA uptime target that may require an exec exception; Karthik, can you confirm if a standard 1% SLA credit is acceptable or whether the redline pushes to 2%?
3) Data residency: they want an EU residency option on the order form. Marcus, can platform confirm whether our Private deploy + VPC option can be scoped in the Order Form or if we need a longer lead time?
4) Compliance: they asked for SOC2 evidence; attaching SOC2_summary_v1.pdf (public summary) — procurement may request auditor letter.

Priority asks for Legal: please review MSA_v3_redline.pdf and mark must-fix vs. negotiable clauses inline. If negotiation requires exec sign-off, flag immediately so we don't slip the end-of-June window.

I'll set a short internal sync at 3:30 PT today if folks can make it; otherwise we'll coordinate over chat.

Attachments: SOC2_summary_v1.pdf, MSA_v3_redline.pdf

Thanks,
Rachel

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@medshift.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: sara.white@medshift.com
Date: Sat, 02 Jun 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + initial MSA redline and order form template

Rachel — appreciate the quick turnaround and the proposed sequencing. A few clarifications from procurement / legal:

- Liability cap: MedShift prefers a 3x revenue cap for pilot agreements; for enterprise we move to a higher threshold. If Redwood can confirm 3x for the pilot term we'll avoid exec escalation.
- SLA: they are pushing for a 99.9% SLA with escrow-style crediting — can you map that to your standard SLA table so we can evaluate the delta?
- Data residency: priority is EU (Ireland). If the Order Form can include a residency selector (US / EU) and show any lead-time delta that would be ideal.
- Doc/links: we'll keep the MAP as the source of truth (tab "Owners & SLAs"). I'll upload a signed PO template after we finalize the order form.

For transparency, I've added a few inline comments to MSA_v3_redline.pdf where our GC needs clarity. Happy to do the 30-min call Monday — 10:00 PT works for us.

Attachments: (see inline comments on) MSA_v3_redline.pdf

Best,
Alex

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>

Alex / Sara — thanks, all. Quick summary and next steps from our side after internal legal & platform triage:

- Liability cap: legal can accept 3x revenue for the 6‑month pilot without exec sign-off; we'll reflect that in our redline and return by EOD Tuesday.
- SLA: Laura will surface the standard SLA table and the incremental delta to 99.9% (including credit mechanics) in the call; tech will confirm any operational constraints for EU residency.
- Data residency: Marcus confirms we can offer EU (Ireland) via private deployment; order form will include a check-box and a 3–4 week lead time for dedicated capacity (we'll call that out explicitly).
- Evidence: Karthik noted SOC2 summary is fine as an initial deliverable; procurement may still ask for auditor letter — flag if that arrives.

I've scheduled the 30-min alignment for Mon 10:00–10:30 PT and included a short agenda: 1) MAP owners & milestones, 2) MSA redline items that affect cadence, 3) Order Form residency options. DocuSign prep link (pre-draft) is below in case we reach signature readiness after the call.
